sermon.title: Persecution has a Face--June 14, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: After worship, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that persecution has a face. He traces Absalom’s conspiracy against David, which drew naive followers until David was restored. He relates American history and the great awakenings to how God corrects His church, and declares that Jesus will present a glorious church, since no one can checkmate Him.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Where do we keep our eyes?
faqs.answer: On Jesus; no matter what is happening, we look unto Him to bring us through.

faqs.question: Can anyone checkmate Jesus?
faqs.answer: No. You can’t checkmate Jesus; He always has another move.
